items.briefing:
Cybersecurity leaders are warning that insider threats are becoming more sophisticated, meaning staff with legitimate system access pose a growing risk — whether through carelessness or malicious intent. Separately, large organisations are being targeted by fake merger and acquisition scams, where criminals impersonate executives or advisors to trick staff into transferring funds or sharing sensitive information. Australian organisations should be alert to unexpected approaches around business deals.

Yubico has expanded its partnership with OpenAI into Australia, supporting a push toward hardware-backed passkeys as a more secure login method. If your organisation still relies on passwords alone, now is a good time to ask your IT team about stronger authentication options.

**Tip:** Be sceptical of any urgent requests involving financial transactions or sensitive documents — always verify through a second, independent channel before acting.

featured.title: AI adoption puts pressure on campus and branch networks
featured.summary: Most organisations are unprepared for AI traffic surges, with 73% expecting campus and branch network capacity limits within two years.
